adaptations: Source float seconds become an explicit exact integer-microsecond/remainder teaching model with positive integer token/second rates. Full buckets discard excess fractional credit. Backward time uses max(now,last_refill).

RPM uses admitted timestamps in a 60-second sliding window, not another token bucket. Legal sorted history may exceed max RPM; retry must wait for enough expiries. Policies are fixed per user and lock scope is in-process only.
SQLite atomic ledger, finite Prometheus exposition and finite user/model/category report are local engineering extensions; source has no persistence, monitoring server or recursive tree API.
Prices are illustrative injected fixture cards, not current commercial facts; no true daily quota, cache semantic search, real provider or model calls.
No source demos/tests or source-directory Python execution. External evidence remains under absolute /tmp paths.

Complete usage persistence is provided by UsageJournal on the LedgerStore connection without transaction management. Candidate bucket-state persistence and atomic composition remain TODO; no candidate raw decimal storage projection is hidden in a helper.
